title: Full Body + French Contrast
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: Walking Lunge × 6/side · Inchworm Shoulder Tap × 5 · Bird Dog × 6/side
jumps: Goblet Squat 3 (heavy, RPE 8) → Lateral Bounds 3/side → DB Jump Squat 5 → Pogo Hops 10
Rest 10–20 sec between steps, 3:00 between rounds
strength: Rest 1:30 · same tempo as the week's main lifts
note: Eccentric wk 2: more weight on the bar, 5-second lowering. Write down your heavy-step weight.
